paper_notes.fornaro_2024: Funding: none (abstract; Role of the funding source). Interests: E.V., M.S., M.F. and A.d.B. report industry ties, including Idorsia, Merck and Takeda; others none. Text misprints: p. 19 triazolam CI against placebo (lower bound 0.06; Fig. 2: 1.06); p. 20 triazolam and zolpidem 20 mg middle-of-the-night against zopiclone reprint the placebo values (Fig. 2: 0.82, 0.40 to 1.24; 0.92, 0.44 to 1.40). Fig. 2 legend gives flurazepam 20 mg; Table 1 and text say 30 mg. Flurazepam enters only the endpoint network.
paper_notes.vermeeren_2004: Narrative review; the author gave no information on funding or conflicts of interest (Acknowledgements, p. 324). The driving-test bands (p. 316) pool morning and afternoon tests and one- or two-night designs, partly in women with insomnia.
paper_notes.johnson_1990: Funded by the US Naval Medical Research and Development Command (Work Unit MR041.01.03-0157); no interests statement. Printed misprints: F(7.65) for F(7,65) (p. 164); Table 2 prints a minus sign on the placebo-placebo 4-choice reaction time (−0.621 against 0.57 to 0.63 in other groups), used by no anchor. The all-caffeine-groups-more-alert result is from the combined sleepiness MANOVA; on the MSLT alone only the higher-dose flurazepam comparison was significant (p. 163).
